---
title: "LaTeX"
---

Install Quarto-managed TinyTeX for Quarto PDF rendering and, optionally, the
TeXstudio editor.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags latex
```

TinyTeX is the default because this workstation primarily uses LaTeX for Quarto PDF
generation. Quarto manages the TinyTeX installation, and the role uses TinyTeX's
`tlmgr` to install the explicitly managed `babel-german` and `hanging` packages.
The role runs `tlmgr` as the target user and only installs packages that are
missing. It also asks Quarto to add TinyTeX to the user's `PATH`.

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual recovery for an incomplete installation**

If TinyTeX is missing or its `tlmgr` package manager does not run, the role asks
Quarto to install it again. It does not delete an incomplete installation. If
Quarto cannot repair it, back up or move `~/.TinyTeX` and rerun the role. The
failure message identifies broken `tlmgr` symlinks separately from missing files
and package-manager errors.
:::

## Install the full Fedora TeX Live scheme

To opt into the complete Fedora distribution, set this variable in your inventory
or group variables:

```yaml
latex_install_texlive_scheme_full: true
```

This installs `texlive-scheme-full` instead of TinyTeX. The full scheme is
intentionally not the default because of its substantial download and installed
size. It also explicitly installs the Fedora `texlive-babel-german` and
`texlive-hanging` packages. The two TeX distributions are never installed together
by this role.

Use `latex_additional_packages` to configure utilities installed with either TeX Live
option. Its default installs the TeXstudio graphical editor:

```yaml
latex_additional_packages:
  - texstudio
```

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
quarto check
pdflatex --version
xelatex --version
kpsewhich german.ldf
kpsewhich hanging.sty
texstudio --version
```
:::
